'''Winera''' was a [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Daimar]]. Her mother, [[Erra]] was of the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar]] and her grandfather was [[Mitar]], the [[King/Legends|king]] of Daimar during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Winera was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar]], the royal house of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]], during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Winera was the daughter of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Erra]] and the granddaughter of [[Mitar]], Daimar's [[King/Legends|king]].<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />

Shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Empire established a [[Blockade of Daimar|blockade]] around Daimar. Concerned for Wilena's wellbeing and determined to prevent her from being captured by the Imperial forces or starving due the impact of the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], King Mitar sent Winera, along with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Alet Komain]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shen-Ji Collun]] to seek out Winera's uncle Prince [[Torrin]], who operated an anti-Imperial resistance group on the planet [[Byrsym]].<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />
